summary: Full regression of the new Stocktakes (Inventering) feature. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed (create/list/get/update/complete/delete, warehouse validation, negative clamping, per-warehouse stock update after complete, movements recorded, double-complete guard, PUT-after-complete guard, cross-user scoping, auth). Frontend: mobile viewport (390x844) walked through Dashboard 'Stocktaking' button -> stocktakes list -> New stocktake modal (warehouse dropdown + date + Create) -> detail screen with 4 sort chips, editable count inputs (blur persists via PUT), std-scan opens camera modal without crash, std-pdf and st-pdf-<id> clicked without crashing the app, std-finish button present. No React Native red screen, no console errors. Product stock was mutated by complete() test but then restored via PUT to preserve original quantities.
action_items: None - feature is functioning end-to-end as specified. Optional: on web, expo-print's printToFileAsync throws (unsupported); the current code awaits it inside try/catch chains at the caller (buttons wrapped in try/catch) so no crash occurs, but you may want to show a user-friendly 'PDF export not supported on web' toast.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stocktake number generator uses _so_counter_key (shared with sales orders) with a separate collection st_counters + period key, which is fine and produces unique INV<yymm><seq> numbers.
PUT /api/stocktakes/{id} correctly clamps negative counted_qty to 0 and preserves system_qty/name/sku/barcode on existing items.
Complete endpoint properly recomputes total = sum(stock.values()) and inserts 'adjust' movements only when prev != counted; snapshot recorded.
Scoping via {'owner_id': {'$in': user['_scope']}} is consistent across all 5 endpoints -> unrelated user correctly gets 404.
Frontend /stocktakes/[id].tsx uses expo-camera (correct, expo-barcode-scanner is deprecated) - GOOD.
All interactive elements have proper testIDs and use Pressable/TouchableOpacity/TextInput RN components.
server.py is ~1925 lines - consider splitting into feature routers for maintainability (not blocking).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable web flows (barcode hardware scan not testable on web per instructions)
